review_role: Independent AI-assisted reference-contract review, not a human annotator and not the evaluated extractor
chronology_evidence: Evaluated results directory was empty at review; root reports no evaluated requests yet. This is process evidence, not a cryptographically trusted timestamp.

checks.check: Exactly the six blind task IDs; all reference objects satisfy generic schema
Evidence quotes are exact source-description substrings
No invented answer normalization, numeric tolerance or partial-credit allocation
Boolean tokens follow explicit True/False wording
Inherent mathematical type distinguished from explicit serialization instructions
Reference does not claim actual human annotation, observed human time or causal savings

per_task_semantic_review.basis: Consistent injective positional character replacement; repeats consistent; self-mapping allowed; Boolean True/False.
Occurrence-count containment and each magazine letter used at most once; no invented subsequence/order constraint.
All courses admit completion under every b-before-a prerequisite; Boolean, not ordering-list output.
Prime count includes both integer endpoints; inherent count type is integer; no explicit integer-literal serialization policy.
Requested numeric direction, exact input multiplicities, square-bracketed list with string elements; no lexicographic sorting or fixed example answer.
Same rational value in lowest terms, nonzero integer denominator and coprime components; fraction-only final answer; no invented positive-denominator/sign/parser restriction.

limits: Both reference author and reviewer are AI assistants. The reference is assisted and fallible, not independent human ground truth.
Field revision counts are a review-burden proxy; no causal human-effort saving follows.
Templates, not independent concrete task-instance samples.
